gold.gold_rationale: Clause 12(5) conditions breach on explicit consent (breach -> consent). 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT rejects any transaction that would exceed ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT (lines 403-411) and the main loop never posts a failed transaction (lines 211-216), making the antecedent always false and the conditional vacuously satisfied, per the adjudication note.

provenance.annotator_notes: Adjudicated 2026-07-27: Pass 1 read the blanket rejection of over-limit transactions as conformant (D7); Pass 2 read the absent consent-capture path as a missing rule (D2). Resolved on the clause's own grammar: 'shall not be breached... without explicit consent' is the conditional breach -> consent. CBTRN02C's 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT makes the antecedent always false (no transaction that would breach the limit is ever posted, lines 403-411 reject it via WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON=102, and the main loop never posts a failed transaction, lines 211-216), which satisfies the conditional regardless of whether a distinct consent mechanism exists. The cited text conditions breach on consent; it does not separately mandate that a consent-gated override path be offered. Pass 1's reading is accepted.
